description: Implement ProviderManager with explicit routing policy (NORMAL/HISTORICAL: [Ryzellx, OpenLigaDB]; LIVE: [FotMob, Ryzellx, OpenLigaDB]; MATCH_DETAIL: [Ryzellx, FotMob, OpenLigaDB]; TEAM/PLAYER/LEAGUE: [Ryzellx, FotMob (where supported), OpenLigaDB (where supported)]). Failover triggers: timeout, HTTP failure, invalid/unusable data, ProviderError. Do NOT failover because a valid optional field is missing (xG=None is NOT a failover trigger). SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RULE: For each response, select ONE provider as authoritative — never produce hybrid result mixing data from multiple providers. Expose selected_provider, attempted_providers, fallback_used, fetched_at, provider_error (sanitized) in response metadata.
steps: Create backend/app/providers/manager.py with ProviderManager class. Constructor: __init__(ryzellx: RyzellxFootballProvider, fotmob: FotMobFootballProvider, openligadb: OpenLigaDBFootballProvider, cache: Optional[ProviderCache] = None). Store provider instances and cache.

Define routing policy as class constants: NORMAL_ORDER = ['ryzellx', 'openligadb']; LIVE_ORDER = ['fotmob', 'ryzellx', 'openligadb']; MATCH_DETAIL_ORDER = ['ryzellx', 'fotmob', 'openligadb']; METADATA_ORDER = ['ryzellx', 'fotmob', 'openligadb'].

Implement async _try_providers(operation: str, provider_order: List[str], provider_method_map: dict[str, Callable]) -> Tuple[Optional[Any], dict[str, Any]]. Iterate provider_order, call provider_method_map[provider_name](). On ProviderTimeoutError, ProviderHTTPError, ProviderInvalidDataError, ProviderError: log error, append to attempted_providers, try next. On success: return (result, metadata). Metadata dict: selected_provider, attempted_providers, fallback_used (bool, True if not first provider), fetched_at, provider_error (sanitized message if fallback occurred, else None). IMPORTANT: Do NOT failover if result is valid but has optional field = None (e.g., xG=None). Only failover on exception or None result when data is required.

Implement async get_matches_by_date(date: date) -> Tuple[List[ProviderMatch], dict]. Use NORMAL_ORDER. Provider method map: {'ryzellx': lambda: self.ryzellx.get_matches_by_date(date), 'openligadb': lambda: self.openligadb.get_matches_by_date(date), 'fotmob': lambda: self.fotmob.get_matches_by_date(date)}. Call _try_providers. Return (matches, metadata).

Implement async get_match(match_id: str, prefer_live: bool = False) -> Tuple[Optional[ProviderMatch], dict]. If prefer_live=True, use LIVE_ORDER; else use MATCH_DETAIL_ORDER. Provider method map: {'ryzellx': ..., 'fotmob': ..., 'openligadb': ...}. Call _try_providers. Return (match, metadata).

Implement async get_live_matches() -> Tuple[List[ProviderLiveMatch], dict]. Use LIVE_ORDER. Provider method map: {'fotmob': lambda: self.fotmob.get_live_matches(), 'ryzellx': lambda: self.ryzellx.get_live_matches(), 'openligadb': lambda: []}. Return (matches, metadata).
Implement async get_team(team_id: str) -> Tuple[Optional[ProviderTeam], dict]. Use METADATA_ORDER. Provider method map for Ryzellx, FotMob (if supported), OpenLigaDB. Return (team, metadata).
Implement async get_player(player_id: str), get_league(league_id: str), get_standings(league_id: str) following same pattern with METADATA_ORDER.

Add docstrings explaining routing policy, failover rules, and SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RULE: 'For every response, ONE provider is selected as the authoritative source. Never produce hybrid results mixing data from multiple providers (e.g., Ryzellx score + FotMob xG). Choose one provider response, attach source metadata, return that normalized result.' Add comment: 'Failover only on exception or None result — NOT on missing optional field (xG=None is valid, not a failover trigger).'
acceptance_criteria: ProviderManager implements all required async methods (get_matches_by_date, get_match, get_live_matches, get_team, get_player, get_league, get_standings)
Routing policy matches specification: NORMAL uses [Ryzellx, OpenLigaDB]; LIVE uses [FotMob, Ryzellx, OpenLigaDB]; MATCH_DETAIL uses [Ryzellx, FotMob, OpenLigaDB]
Failover triggers on ProviderTimeoutError, ProviderHTTPError, ProviderInvalidDataError, ProviderError, or None result when data required
Failover does NOT trigger on missing optional field (xG=None keeps Ryzellx as source)
SOURCE-OF-TRUTH RULE enforced: each response comes from ONE provider, never hybrid
Metadata includes: selected_provider, attempted_providers, fallback_used, fetched_at, provider_error (sanitized)
